gotchas: Strictly restricted to AI programming scenarios (OpenCode, OpenClaw, Claude Code, Cline, Codex); generic API scraping or non-coding backends are prohibited and subject to API key revocation
Platform allows only 1 active subscription package per account; upgrades are supported by paying the pro-rata price difference, but downgrading is disallowed
When the monthly Credit quota is exhausted, service halts safely without automatic overdraft or balance depletion
MiMo-V2.5-Pro-UltraSpeed (>1,000 TPS TileRT engine) is not included in the Token Plan quota and must be accessed via PAYG
Nighttime off-peak rate: UTC 16:00-24:00 (Beijing 0:00-8:00) consumes credits at 0.8x coefficient (+25% yield bonus)
Unused credits do not roll over to subsequent months and are non-refundable once activated
tosHighlights: Includes regional proxy clusters in Singapore, Europe (Amsterdam), and China with native OpenAI and Anthropic compatibility
TTS voice synthesis models are free for a limited time and do not deplete Token Plan credits
Zero balance drain: service cutoffs prevent surprise charges on underlying account balance
dataTraining: Standard platform terms apply to consumer subscriptions; zero data retention and enterprise isolation available under enterprise contracts
stackingPolicyNote: Platform terms: "Currently, the platform only supports purchasing 1 package at a time" and API keys are tied strictly to the individual subscribing account; proxying or non-coding API access is prohibited.
